compatibility_patch.description: The exact new ResetDefeatCredit implementations are applied to the verified snapshot's older XP/item modules, retaining its established save and three-byte material ABI. Current modules contain additional unrelated work and are compile-checked separately, not substituted into this executable.

blender.fallback: Isolated background authoring and packaging; live scene unchanged

limitations: Four-actor capped 20-Hz cadence is a smoke comparison, not an uncapped GPU benchmark.

Native QA pins Link, camera and time. Real arrows/nut shockwave exercise collision; the first complete respawn is observed, later hidden delays are shortened, and one ice fixture is pre-injured to two health. Duplicate callbacks are injected solely to test one-time credit.
Ordinary targeting, dive contact and weapon inputs were observed, but a manual defeat was not confirmed. Twelve earned defeats and the natural giant cycle are verified by the native harness.
Natural scene placements, child Link, Skull Mask/horse conditions, randomized enemy sizes, broader terrain and third-party texture packs remain additional acceptance coverage.
Bounds and endpoint checks do not prove triangle-level intersection clearance.
